mutations.name: a question counts twice toward its sentence
kills: tallying one chapter's reply counts questions per sentence, with zeros, and density over the chapter's sentences

mutations.name: density divides by one sentence too many
kills: tallying one chapter's reply counts questions per sentence, with zeros, and density over the chapter's sentences

mutations.name: a list inside one sentence is flagged as spread
kills: tallying one chapter's reply flags a list whose items fall in two or more sentences, in chapter order, and not one in a single sentence

mutations.name: a term matches inside a longer word
kills: tallying one chapter's reply matches a term as whole words only

mutations.name: a chapter at the threshold reports red
kills: the listener verdict fails a chapter above the threshold and names it, and passes one at it
